about: Hand-written exp87 rule questions. options[0] is correct (shuffled at build). evidence must appear in the cited text in force on as_of (or in the document at path). Written from the state-policy-docs corpus, not from the Cornell quiz.

questions.stem: Under federal SNAP rules, a person in an institution of higher education is subject to the student eligibility restrictions when enrolled at what level?
options: Any enrollment, even a single class
Only in a four-year degree program
questions.evidence: enrolled at least half-time in an institution of higher education

questions.stem: How many hours of paid work does a student need to meet the SNAP work exemption from the student rule?
questions.evidence: employed for a minimum of 20 hours per week

questions.stem: Which ages exempt a student from the SNAP student eligibility rule?
options: Age 17 or younger, or 50 or older
questions.evidence: be age 17 or younger or age 50 or older

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, above what age is an individual excepted from the ABAWD time limit in fiscal year 2025?
questions.evidence: fiscal year 2025 and each fiscal year thereafter over 55 years of age

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, above what age is an individual excepted from the ABAWD time limit?
questions.evidence: under 18, or over 65, years of age

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, is a homeless individual excepted from the ABAWD time limit?
options: No, homelessness is not an exception
Only in areas with a waiver
Only if the person is also a veteran
Only if the person is 24 or younger
questions.evidence: (f) a homeless individual

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, a parent or household member is excepted from the ABAWD time limit for responsibility for a dependent child of what age?
questions.evidence: dependent child under 14 years of age

questions.stem: Under federal SNAP rules, how many countable months can an ABAWD who is not meeting the work requirement receive benefits?
questions.evidence: more than three countable months during any three-year period

questions.stem: How many hours of work satisfy the ABAWD work requirement?
options: 20 hours a week averaged monthly (80 hours a month)
questions.evidence: 20 hours a week averaged monthly means 80 hours a month

questions.stem: Which ages are exempt from the general SNAP work requirements?
questions.evidence: a person younger than 16 years of age or a person 60 years of age or older

questions.stem: Above what monthly amount are an elderly or disabled member's medical expenses deductible?
questions.evidence: medical expenses in excess of $35 per month

questions.stem: Whose medical expenses count toward the SNAP excess medical deduction?
options: Household members who are elderly or disabled
questions.evidence: incurred by any household member who is elderly or disabled

questions.stem: Which household is entitled to expedited service under the low-income test?
options: Gross monthly income under $150 and liquid resources of $100 or less
Gross monthly income under $500 and resources under $1,000
Gross monthly income under $150 and resources under $500
Gross monthly income under $300 and resources of $100 or less
Gross monthly income under $100 and resources under $150
questions.evidence: households with less than $150 in monthly gross income

questions.stem: By when must benefits be available to a household entitled to expedited service?
options: By the 7th calendar day after the application was filed
questions.evidence: not later than the seventh calendar day following the date an application was filed

questions.stem: What is the normal processing standard for a SNAP application?
options: No later than 30 calendar days after filing
questions.evidence: no later than 30 calendar days following the date the application was filed

questions.stem: Apart from transitional benefits and the listed exceptions, what is the longest SNAP certification period?
questions.evidence: the certification period cannot exceed 12 months

questions.stem: For a household in which all adult members are elderly or disabled, how long may the state certify it?
questions.evidence: may certify for up to 24 months households in which all adult members are elderly or disabled

questions.stem: A 20-year-old lives with a parent but buys and prepares food separately. How is the 20-year-old treated?
options: Must be in the same SNAP household as the parent
May apply as a separate household
Is included only if a student
questions.evidence: a person under 22 years of age who is living with his or her natural or adoptive parent(s)

questions.stem: At what age is a household member considered elderly for SNAP?
questions.evidence: is sixty years of age or older

questions.stem: What is the disqualification period for a first intentional Program violation (not involving trafficking or other special cases)?
questions.evidence: for a period of twelve months for the first intentional program violation

questions.stem: Within what period may a household request a fair hearing on a state agency action?
options: Actions that occurred in the prior 90 days
questions.evidence: which occurred in the prior 90 days

questions.stem: How much advance notice must a notice of adverse action give at minimum?
options: At least 10 days from the date it is mailed
questions.evidence: includes at least 10 days from the date the notice is mailed

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, what share of benefit costs does a state with a payment error rate of 8.5% pay, once the cost share applies?
questions.evidence: equal to or greater than 8 percent but less than 10 percent

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, what share of benefit costs does a state with a payment error rate of 6.7% pay, once the cost share applies?
questions.evidence: equal to or greater than 6 percent but less than 8 percent

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, when does the state share of benefit costs based on payment error rates begin?
questions.evidence: beginning in fiscal year 2028

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, which households must be given a heating and cooling standard utility allowance because they received a LIHEAP payment of more than $20?
options: Any household that received such a payment in the current month or the prior 12 months
Only households with an elderly or disabled member that received such a payment
Any household that received any LIHEAP payment, regardless of amount
Only households that pay heating costs directly to a utility
None; LIHEAP receipt does not affect the utility allowance
questions.evidence: shall be made available to households that received a payment

questions.stem: Under the Food and Nutrition Act as in force on that date, which households must be given a heating and cooling standard utility allowance because they received a LIHEAP payment of more than $20?
options: Only households with an elderly or disabled member that received such a payment
Any household that received such a payment in the current month or the prior 12 months
Any household that received any LIHEAP payment, regardless of amount
Only households that pay heating costs directly to a utility
None; LIHEAP receipt does not affect the utility allowance
questions.evidence: shall be made available to households with an elderly or disabled member that received a payment

questions.stem: How is the SNAP minimum benefit for eligible one- and two-person households set?
options: 8 percent of the maximum allotment for a household of one
10 percent of the maximum allotment for a household of one
5 percent of the maximum allotment for a household of two
questions.evidence: 8 percent of the maximum allotment for a household of one

questions.stem: If a household's prorated benefit for its initial month comes to less than $10, what is issued for that month?
options: The amount, added to the next month
questions.evidence: allotment of less than $10, then no issuance shall be made for the initial month

questions.stem: The excess shelter deduction covers shelter costs above what share of household income after other deductions?
questions.evidence: exceeds an amount equal to 50 percent of monthly household income after all other applicable deductions

questions.stem: What share of gross earned income is deducted as the earned income deduction?
questions.evidence: twenty percent of gross earned income

questions.stem: For the dependent care deduction, care for a child of what age can be deducted?
questions.evidence: including care of a child under the age of 18

questions.stem: Under simplified reporting, when must a non-exempt household certified for longer than 6 months file a periodic report?
options: Between 4 and 6 months into the certification period
questions.evidence: must file a periodic report between 4 months and 6 months

questions.stem: What residency rule applies to a SNAP applicant household?
options: It must live in the state where it applies
It must have lived in the state for 30 days
It must have lived in the state for 6 months
It must have a permanent street address
It must be registered to vote in the state
questions.evidence: a household shall live in the state in which it files an application

questions.stem: What is required regarding Social Security numbers?
options: Each household member must provide an SSN or apply for one before certification
Only the head of household must provide one
SSNs must be provided within 90 days after certification
questions.evidence: provide the state agency with the social security number (ssn) of each household member or apply for one before certification

questions.stem: How are educational grants and scholarships that meet the regulation's conditions treated?
options: Counted in full as unearned income
questions.evidence: educational assistance, including grants, scholarships, fellowships, work study

questions.stem: In California, from when do the H.R. 1 noncitizen eligibility rules apply to new CalFresh applications?
options: Applications received on or after April 1, 2026
questions.evidence: the guidance set forth in this acl is effective april 1, 2026

questions.stem: From when does California apply the H.R. 1 ABAWD time limit policy?
questions.evidence: the guidance provided via this letter is effective june 1, 2026

questions.stem: In California, a CalFresh application is received on May 29, 2026 and approved in June 2026. Under which ABAWD exemption criteria is the applicant screened?
options: The pre-H.R. 1 criteria, because the application was received before June 1, 2026
The H.R. 1 criteria, because it was approved after June 1, 2026
The criteria in effect on the day of the interview
None; ABAWDs are not screened for exemptions
questions.evidence: applications received before june 1, 2026 must be screened under the pre- hr1 rules

questions.stem: When does California's new statewide 36-month ABAWD clock start?
questions.evidence: beginning january 1, 2026, a new statewide 36-month abawd clock will start

questions.stem: In California, which programs meet the Local Program that Increases Employability (LPIE) criteria for the student exemption, effective June 1, 2026?
options: All undergraduate degree programs at CCC, CSU and UC campuses
Only programs approved one by one by CDSS
Only programs that include work study
None; the LPIE exemption was eliminated
questions.evidence: effective june 1, 2026, all undergraduate degree programs offered at the ccc, csu, or uc campus meet the lpie criteria

questions.stem: Through when is California's CalFresh Standard Medical Deduction demonstration project authorized?
questions.evidence: effective october 1, 2025, through september 30, 2029

questions.stem: In a SNAP QC review, what is it called when the QC-verified allotment for the sample month is compared with the authorized allotment?
questions.evidence: the qc verified allotment for sample month is compared to the authorized allotment (comparison i)
